name: Ouchi de Kurasou!
source:
Main character lives with three brothers-in-law and two sisters-in-law while parents are working abroad. But one day brother-in-law suddenly confesses, and ordinary Japanese man's life gets crushed.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
父母在海外工作期间，主角与三个姐夫和两个嫂子共同生活。然而有一天，姐夫突然向他告白，普通日本男人的生活就此崩溃。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
